en.title: New Vehicle Accessibility Grant Launched; CSS Guide and Park Board Improve Disability Access
en.summary: A provincial government has launched a grant program to fund vehicle accessibility modifications for people with disabilities, addressing mobility barriers. Meanwhile, a practical guide on CSS Grid and Flexbox now includes accessibility strategies for inclusive web design, and a communication board installed at Hasbrouck Park in New Paltz enhances access for individuals with communication disabilities. Together, these efforts highlight advancing accessibility across transportation, digital, and public spaces.

highlights.title: Province Launches Vehicle Accessibility Grant Program
Guide to CSS Grid and Flexbox Includes Accessibility Strategies
Communication board at Hasbrouck Park in New Paltz improves accessibility

zh-TW.title: 省政府推出車輛無障礙補助；CSS指南及公園溝通板提升無障礙
zh-TW.summary: 省政府近日推出車輛無障礙補助計畫，旨在為殘障人士資助車輛改造，減少移動障礙。同時，CSS Grid 與 Flexbox 實用指南新增無障礙策略，以支援包容性網頁設計；紐帕爾茨 Hasbrouck 公園的溝通板則提升溝通障礙人士的無障礙程度。這些措施共同推進交通、數位與公共空間的無障礙環境。

highlights.title: 省政府推出車輛無障礙補助計畫
CSS Grid 與 Flexbox 指南包含無障礙策略
紐帕爾茨 Hasbrouck 公園的溝通板提升無障礙程度
